about: The kit's material slots, by the name each kit model gives them: the one home for which shared master material a slot takes (his order of 21 October 2026, item 5: shared Unreal master materials made once from the material slot names). The starting values are each model's own (the target's base colour, roughness and metallic as built into the glb, read by tools/ue/make_kit_materials.py); the look is then made in Unreal against the Hook sheet, as the overrides below, never in the models. A slot not named here keeps the glTF importer's material, and the import reports it.
pieces_note: the kit pieces the street places, each a joined copy in ledger/Assets/Props/base-mesh (tools/art-recipes/kit_for_game.py), named by its scene item's asset; tools/ue/import_prop_meshes.py dresses their slots from this file and the game drives their glowing slots (VignetteShot.cpp BindKitPiece).

masters.opaque: /Game/Ledger/Kit/M_LedgerKit: base colour, roughness, metallic, specular and an emissive colour, as parameters
masters.translucent: /Game/Ledger/Kit/M_LedgerKitGlass: the same with opacity, translucent, lit on its surface

glass.note: clear or yellowed glass and acrylic; shadow casting off on its sections

concrete.weather_note: 21 October, his ruling (the page's answer): the columns stay concrete, but clean concrete looks cheap: weathered and a shade darker before it counts as done. Rain streaks down the vertical faces (a drawn map of runs, tools/props/make_kit_detail.py), a greenish growth on faces turned to the sky, and a stronger grime band at the foot; starting points judged in the camera. Try 2 (the close view's review, 'an even grain like a timber pole'): 22 wider, varied runs hanging from the top of the piece and fading down 2.6 m.

lamp.note: a lamp's glowing part: pale when cold, lit by the lanterns' drive at night

lamp_jacket.note: a lamp's clear glass jacket: see-through by day (the arc tube shows inside), lit by the lanterns' drive at night (21 October: the opaque 'lamp' kind read as a solid white rod from below, the close view's review)

concrete_C.overrides_note: 21 October, his ruling: a shade darker again, 0.85 of the 13:50 value (0.195, 0.188, 0.170), itself 0.68 of the target's linear (146, 143, 136); before that the glb's colour rendered near-white beside the street.

plate.used_by: lamp_post_C (the number plate, its letters the engine's)

reflector.used_by: lamp_post_C (the white reflector inside the canopy)

bowl.used_by: lamp_post_C (the yellowed acrylic bowl; lit 4,800 cd/m2 against the tube's 91,700)
bowl.overrides_note: 21 October: from below the bowl read as an open white dish, no yellowing, no surface (the close view's review); the glb's near-white at opacity 0.35 vanished against the sky. Yellowed acrylic, judged in the camera: a cream-amber at 0.55 opacity.

lamp_glass.used_by: lamp_post_C (the lamp's glass jacket; 27,500 cd/m2 lit)

arc_tube.used_by: lamp_post_C (the U-shaped arc tube; 91,700 cd/m2 lit)
arc_tube.overrides_note: 21 October, try 2 of the close view's 'the jacket reads as a solid rod': a cold low-pressure sodium arc tube is a darker amber-brown U (its sodium film), so it reads inside the clear jacket; the glb's pale grey made tube and jacket one pale rod. The jacket's opacity 0.3 -> 0.15.

lit_emissive_note: 21 October 2026: the arc tube's emissive at night in this engine's unitless units, in the lanterns' colour (unreal-look.json lantern_linear_rgb, the lights' own). A starting point, derived not picked: the bowl, which is what the street sees lit, then glows 0.052 x 3.0 = 0.16, the same as the old Blender lamp head's lens it replaces (its night glow 8.0 x street_glow_gain 0.02), which the night frames were tuned with. Judged in the game camera against the Hook sheet from there.
glow_note: glow is each slot's lit brightness relative to the arc tube (production/cloud-week/targets/lamp-posts/target.json, materials: lamp_glass 27,500, bowl 4,800 and the tube 91,700 cd/m2, colour (255, 137, 0)); the game multiplies it by the lantern's emissive strength when the lanterns are on, and sets it to 0 by day.
detail_note: detail and dirt (21 October, production/research/aaa-street/KIT-MATERIALS-2026-10-21.md): detail.map names a map made by tools/props/make_kit_detail.py from the street's own photographs (concrete, stone, metal, brick), world-aligned every size_cm, multiplying the colour by up to about a third (intensity) and moving roughness (rough); dirt darkens a piece's foot height_cm up from its lowest point toward colour by strength. Starting points, judged in the game camera against the Hook sheet.
